title: Use a for loop to add a group of numbers
description: Choose a range of numbers. Start a total variable at 0, use a for loop to add each number to the total, and print the final total after the loop.
solution:
total = 0
for number in range(1, 6):
    total += number
print(total)

title: Print a multiplication table using a for loop
description: Choose any number, such as 7. Use a for loop to multiply it by at least three counting numbers, and print each answer to make a small multiplication table.
solution:
for number in range(1, 4):
    print(7 * number)
